notes: The 2026-2027 catalog's World Languages and Cultures pages list no Spanish A.A. degree. The 'Programs Offered' table lists Spanish AA-T (V032853G), Foreign Languages AA, French AA, German AA, Italian AA and the Spanish Language Skills Certificate only. No section was recorded because none matches the named award.

The closed list does not appear to describe the AA-T. It lacks HISTORY 005/006, which the AA-T's List A requires. It also includes SPANISH 48, which the text does not print. The Spanish A.A. may have been discontinued or may belong to another catalog year. A reviewer should check whether this record should instead read the Associate in Arts in Spanish for Transfer section (Major Units: 18-25; Total Minimum Units: 60; Cal-GETC).
The Spanish Language Skills Certificate section is cut off mid-outcome at the end of the text.
